acceptanceCriteria: A lane can reserve a requirement ID range per spec
A colliding definition across open lane branches is reported before merge
body: Friction from the pool-checkpoint lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-pool-checkpoint, V1-1701 and V1-0895). Observed: corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md is one CAL-V0 number space edited by many concurrent lanes with no reservation file; the lane jumped to CAL-V0-380 by hand to avoid collisions. Expected: a reservation record (or a check) that refuses colliding requirement IDs across open branches before merge.
title: Shared-spec requirement ID reservations for concurrent lanes
